strings.game.school.disclaimer: A game, not a substitute for an instructor. The principles here are the basics instructors teach in the first days.
strings.game.school.intro: Seven short lessons, from your first stop to carving. Each lesson has one principle and a drill built just for it: different controls, different tasks, and a coach who tells you in real time what is happening and why.
strings.game.school.lesson1_controls: The skis go straight on their own. Drag a finger up and down; the slider on the side sets the pizza width: down is wide, up is narrow.
strings.game.school.lesson1_drill: Three stop lines: stop completely just before each one, then narrow the pizza and carry on. Between line 2 and line 3 there is a green band: hold 6 to 10 km/h there using the pizza width.
strings.game.school.lesson1_goal2: Hold your speed in the green band
strings.game.school.lesson1_goal3: Stop within 1.5 m of the line on average
strings.game.school.lesson1_rule: In a pizza, the ski tips are close together and the tails are apart. Push the tails out with your heels. The wider the pizza, the stronger the braking. A narrow pizza only slows you down.
strings.game.school.lesson2_controls: Two buttons: left ski and right ski. Press one, and that is the ski carrying all your weight.
strings.game.school.lesson2_drill: Six gates, alternating left and right. Before each gate the coach asks which way you are turning, and you choose which ski to press.
strings.game.school.lesson2_goal3: All gates, with at most one wrong press
strings.game.school.lesson2_rule: To turn left, press on the right ski, the outside one. To turn right, press on the left one. It is the opposite of what it seems at first, which is why we practice it.
strings.game.school.lesson3_controls: The skis turn toward your finger. At first just watch: a few seconds straight down, to feel how fast it speeds up.
strings.game.school.lesson3_drill: Four speed traps: pass each one under 22 km/h, no pizza. The coach tells you at every moment whether you are speeding up or slowing down.
strings.game.school.lesson3_goal3: All speed traps, never above 35 km/h
strings.game.school.lesson3_rule: Without a pizza, you control speed with the shape of your turn. Straight down the slope speeds you up. Diagonally, less so. Across the slope slows you down. Every turn that finishes across the slope is a brake.
strings.game.school.lesson4_controls: Tap anywhere on the screen to start a turn the other way. No need to aim.
strings.game.school.lesson4_drill: A metronome ticks. Tap exactly on the beat. Every tap gets a grade: perfect, good, early or late. Miss a beat and your speed goes up.
strings.game.school.lesson4_goal1: 10 turns on the beat (good or perfect)
strings.game.school.lesson4_goal3: A streak of 8 turns on the beat
strings.game.school.lesson4_rule: A good skier turns in a steady rhythm: each turn starts as the last one ends. Start early, not when the tree is already in front of you. Skis parallel, hip-width apart.
strings.game.school.lesson5_controls: The skis turn toward your finger.
strings.game.school.lesson5_drill: The flags vanish as you get close, just like when you stare at your skis. You only see them from afar, so you plan from afar. Other skiers are on the way.
strings.game.school.lesson5_rule: Look three turns ahead, not at your ski tips. Whoever is skiing ahead of you, below you, always has priority. Pass them with plenty of room.
strings.game.school.lesson6_controls: This time your finger does not steer. It sets how much to tilt: right of center tilts right, left of center tilts left. The gauge at the bottom shows the tilt.
strings.game.school.lesson6_drill: Draw clean arcs: every full turn without skidding is a "clean arc". Two thin lines in the snow mean it worked. A sharp, fast switch smears the snow.
strings.game.school.lesson6_goal3: 8 arcs, with under 1.5 seconds of skidding
strings.game.school.lesson6_rule: In carving you do not twist the skis. You tip them onto the edge, and their shape turns you. More tilt, tighter turn. A sharp switch from edge to edge breaks the grip and you skid.
strings.game.school.lesson7_controls: The skis turn toward your finger. The "Pizza" button brakes.
strings.game.school.lesson7_drill: Gates, other skiers, and a speed limit of 40 km/h.
strings.game.school.lesson7_goal3: And under 40 for 90% of the time
strings.game.school.lesson7_rule: Everything together: eyes ahead, a turn shape that controls your speed, and pizza only when you really need it.
strings.game.school.meta_description: Seven short lessons: the basics of skiing, with practice that feels like real snow

strings.game.school.tip_1: Wide pizza = strong braking. Narrow pizza = gentle slowing. Pizza width is your brake pedal.
strings.game.school.tip_2: To turn left: weight on the right ski. To turn right: on the left.
strings.game.school.tip_3: Don't brake: finish the turn across the slope.
strings.game.school.tip_4: A new turn starts as the last one ends. Steady rhythm = control.
strings.game.school.tip_5: Eyes far ahead. The skier below you always has priority.
strings.game.school.tip_6: Tilt gently and let the edge do the work.
strings.game.school.tip_7: All the principles together. Good luck in Gudauri!
